severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — ANATOMICAL INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: MALFORMED-HAND FRONT SPREADS ACROSS FIVE REGIONS AS SYNTHETIC STOCK IMAGERY DEPLOYS BUSINESS PROFESSIONALS SHAKING HANDS WITH ELEVEN FINGERS BENEATH SIGNAGE THAT SPELLS NOTHING IN ANY KNOWN LANGUAGE
advisory: A slow-moving system of generated imagery has settled over commercial and editorial channels, producing illustrations of confident humans whose hands do not resolve on close inspection. Residents are advised to count fingers before trusting any smiling professional, chef, or golden retriever pictured. The Service notes that affected images are otherwise crisp, well-lit, and entirely load-bearing on articles that do not exist. Do not attempt to read the background text; it is decorative and means nothing.

regional_outlook.conditions: Dense banks of handshake imagery drifting in from the northwest, with several executives observed gripping conference tables that have grown a sixth leg. Finger counts running well above seasonal averages.
Widespread stock-photo haze across the top of every query. How-to articles are illustrated with tools that fuse into the hand at the wrist.
Product mockups showing mugs with two handles and one impossible loop. Buyers report the item that arrives has the correct number of everything, which is its own kind of surprise.
Sentimental imagery pooling in low-lying feeds; grandmothers with warm smiles and asymmetric spectacles, holding cakes that were never baked. Heavy sharing expected through the evening.
Icon and screenshot systems producing user interfaces that cannot be operated by human or synthetic hands. Buttons overlap; text is a smear that gestures at the concept of a word.

specimen.status: Abundant and multiplying; peak season year-round
specimen.habitat: Article headers, hero banners, pitch decks, and any surface requiring a photograph of trust
specimen.field_marks: Perfect lighting, plausible smiles, and hands that betray the whole enterprise on second glance — extra fingers, fused knuckles, wristwatches worn on skin. Background signage renders as confident gibberish. Teeth occasionally exceed the recommended allowance.
specimen.call: Professional Business Team Celebrating Success — royalty-free, 8000×5000, hands not included
specimen.confusion_species: May be mistaken for a genuine licensed stock photograph, which also features implausibly cheerful office workers. Tell them apart by the hands: real stock models are contractually limited to five fingers per hand, a regulation the synthetic specimen has never read.

spotter_tip: When a photo looks trustworthy, count the fingers, then count them again — the confidence is real but the anatomy is negotiable. If the sign in the background says nothing at all in a very legible font, you are looking at a specimen.
tomorrow: Malformed-hand front weakens overnight; residual six-toed pets linger in the Pinterest Shallows through midday.
